method: Actual immutable orderPlacements/groundRoot/spriteFrame and real worldRasterPlan/paintWorldRaster. Native intermediate nearest composition followed by normal SVG/CSS final filtering. Whole source frames only. No fit, snap, masks, alpha/RGB edits, foreground override or per-facing root changes.
scope: Nine discrete representative stances, not continuous staircase locomotion. Current published35degree Rosa and current b176 companions are primary browser input; native55degree full body reference is technical and separately labeled. Approved Hut01 native additional fixture is separately retained.
supportRule: Root-based actual geometric path support: ground approach has no supportedBy; entry when source absX<=.39 and -2<=Y<-1.5; actual deck for source Y>=-1.5 within footprint. Hut/sub supportedBy exact deck placement id. Baseline floor-entry order unchanged.

projection.meaning: Published real35degree actor atlas is primary consumer reference. Native55degree complete-body context is a separate technical physical reference; no cross-projection pixel parity claim.

nativeCohorts.entry: static exact Entry06 at S root[0,-1.5,0]

actor.meaning: Actual unchanged action samples; mixed representative snapshots, not a generated staircase animation.

originalCompanions.evaluation: Exact visible native evaluated mesh/material copies frozen in memory at companion frame12 before actor independently samples frame7 or12. Every snapshot world vertex exactly matches source evaluation. No source blend/action saved or edited.

approvedHutAdditionalFixture.relationship: Separately labeled additional native fixture; current primary consumer uses exact currently published original hut. Future rebuilt submarine clearance not inferred.
